## Allotrope

Different structural form of the same element.

Term ID: `MAT:TERM:000001` · MAT editorial reference · Source review pending.

Origin: [preserved definition](../../data/research/sources/mat-glossary-prose-2026-10-03.md), `heading: Allotrope`.

### Retained wording

Different structural forms of the same element (e.g., diamond vs. graphite for carbon).

Origin: [retained hover definitions](../../data/research/sources/mat-hover-glossary-2026-10-03.json), `table.allotrope`. Source review pending.

## Atomic Radius

Origin: [preserved definition](../../data/research/sources/mat-hover-glossary-2026-10-03.json), `table.atomic radius`.

## Band Gap

Term ID: `MAT:TERM:000032` · MAT editorial reference · Source review pending.

Origin: [preserved definition](../../data/research/sources/mat-hover-glossary-2026-10-03.json), `table.band gap`.

## Data-Extruded Model

A three-dimensional MAT visualization whose geometry is generated from normalized data metrics.

It is not necessarily literal physical geometry.

## Evidence Type

Classification describing how a claim is supported.

```text
REPLICATED
THEORETICAL
COMPUTATIONAL
HYPOTHESIS
```
